Bukhansan

National Park · South Korea

  1. Home
    4. South Korea
    6. Bukhansan

Mountain park on Seoul's northern edge. Baegundae and Insubong peaks, temples and fortress walls. Easily accessible by metro; one of the world's most visited national parks per unit area.
